dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I guess I know a thing or two.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Do you really? Great! I'm afraid I haven't any knowledge myself... In which case, I'd be grateful if you could go see her garden.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: I'd love to help myself, but it seems that deep subject matter knowledge will be required...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Would you be willing to visit her garden and give her some suggestions?
